text:
Maya (Partnerships): Heads up — EdgeCloud + Redwood co-sell POC next week. Need to finalize what telemetry we can expose and the SLA language we can promise. @Evan (EdgeCloud) can you confirm your telemetry requirements? cc: @Jordan (Eng) @Diego (Solutions) @Nisha (Security)
Evan (EdgeCloud): We need request/response latency, token counts, and per-route error rates. Also per-tenant cost metrics for partner billing. Prefer a Prometheus scrape endpoint or a datadog push. Is that doable? :slightly_smiling_face:
Jordan (Eng): We can expose Prometheus at /metrics and add a small webhook for per-request events. Latency + token count per request doable, but we cannot export prompt or response text without DPA/customer consent. I'll sketch a minimal payload we can emit.
Jordan (Eng): Example minimal event we can push to partner HTTPS endpoint:
```json
{"ts":"<iso>", "hashedd_request_id":"<sha256>", "route":"/chat/generate", "latency_ms":124, "tokens_in":32, "tokens_out":140, "status":200}
```
Diego (Solutions): For the pilot contract the product asked for p95 < 300ms. That's tight for cross-tenant routing. Suggest offering 99.5% p95 for the pilot and documenting fallback to a smaller model or queued path if we hit capacity. @Priya what's acceptable from partner negotiations?
Priya (Sales): Partner expects short SLA to use in their SOW. For pricing they want committed burst + per-request metering. We can offer a pilot bundle (flat daily + per-token). I'll draft numbers. Need security signoff on what telemetry we share so partner billing doesn't get raw customer content.
Nisha (Security): We cannot share request bodies, prompts, or responses. Aggregates (token counts, latencies, hashed IDs) are OK with a telemetry appendix in the DPA. Also need to confirm storage/retention and whether partner can access raw logs (they cannot on hosted). Will attach checklist.
Evan (EdgeCloud): Hashed request id + timestamp works for correlation. We want to join traces on our side, so a stable hashed id is ideal. Datadog ingestion with partner account is preferred; what's your retention policy?
Jordan (Eng): Defaults: metrics 90d, traces 30d on hosted. Can extend to 365d for Dedicated/Private. For the pilot we can do 90d. We can also emit rate alerts (error rate > 2% for 5m) and wire alerts into partner PD via webhook.
Maya (Partnerships): Great — action items: 1) Jordan to post /metrics spec + sample event by EOD. 2) Nisha to add telemetry appendix draft for DPA. 3) Priya to draft pilot pricing + SOW language. 4) Evan to confirm Datadog account and retention requirements. 5) Diego to approve pilot SLA wording (99.5% p95). Please ack so I can consolidate into the partner runbook (link below).
Jordan (Eng): Working on spec, will post by EOD.
Nisha (Security): Drafting appendix now, will ping with checklist link.
Priya (Sales): Drafting pricing sheet and SOW. I'll drop the Google sheet here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-example-pilot-pricing
Evan (EdgeCloud): :thumbsup: will confirm Datadog account and retention by tomorrow.
Diego (Solutions): Agree to 99.5% p95 for pilot. Noted.
Sam (Partner Ops): Can we also get a short runbook for on-call escalation (who to ping at Redwood)? We need a single PD entry and an escalation matrix.
Jordan (Eng): Yep — will include PD webhook + escalation contacts in the spec.
Maya (Partnerships): I'll consolidate everything into the shared runbook: https://redwood.ai/partner-runbooks/edgecloud-telemetry. If anything changes, respond here.
deploy-bot: A new runbook page was created by Maya (Partnerships): https://redwood.ai/partner-runbooks/edgecloud-telemetry (viewable by partners with SSO)
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — following up after docs are posted.
